text: Security is a crucial part of web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. This protects sensitive information like passwords. Second, authentication ensures that only authorized users can access certain areas. Strong passwords and two-factor authentication help here. Third, input validation checks what users type into forms, preventing harmful code from entering your system. Common vulnerabilities include SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS), which can steal data or damage your site. By following these practices, developers can build safer websites and protect users from online threats.
